visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) The scene is set in a warehouse or store filled with rows of motorcycle helmets on racks. A man on the right, wearing a beige button-down shirt and a tan cap, is talking and gesturing with his hands. A man on the left, wearing glasses and a black polo shirt, listens with his arms crossed. The lighting is bright and industrial. (2) The focus shifts to a close-up of a yellow and black helmet held by the man in the beige shirt. He uses both hands to pull the sides of the helmet apart, demonstrating a common but incorrect way to put it on. The background remains the shelves of helmets. (3) A brief montage cut shows a laboratory testing environment. A motorcycle helmet is seen inside a specialized rig, where it is subjected to a mechanical impact test. The setting is gray and utilitarian with safety netting. (4) Returning to the warehouse, the man in the beige shirt demonstrates the 'correct' method. He uses an 'OK' hand gesture to pull the chin straps apart while holding the helmet's base. He then slides an orange and black helmet onto his head and secures it. (5) The video ends with a graphic overlay displaying text and a thumbnail image of the two men standing with an older man in what appears to be a manufacturing or testing facility.
visual_base.text_narrative_log: (1) [Variety]: 叫安全帽就一定安全? 配戴正確才有效. [Subtitle]: 很多人都覺得. (2) [Subtitle]: 會做安全帽的人. (3) [Subtitle]: 他就能夠做出安全的安全帽. (4) [Subtitle]: 但是很多人連戴安全帽, 他都不會戴安全帽. (5) [Subtitle]: 不是啊, 戴安全帽有什麼難的. (6) [Subtitle]: 戴安全帽更難. (7) [Subtitle]: 你講這個話真的是. (8) [Subtitle]: 這樣就把它掰開啊, 這樣子然後塞進去啊. (9) [Variety]: 我跟你講, 不會戴安全帽. [Subtitle]: 當劉備你把兩隻手. (10) [Subtitle]: 這樣子掰開的時候, 其實你的外殼跟妳裡面的保麗龍. (11) [Subtitle]: 還有你的整個結構, 基本上就是已經變形了. (12) [Subtitle]: 當結構整個變形的時候呢, 你的衝擊效應跟你保護頭的能力. (13) [Subtitle]: 就沒那麼好. (14) [Subtitle]: 所以一個正確的安全帽應該怎麼戴呢. (15) [Subtitle]: 首先你要比出你的OK手勢. (16) [Subtitle]: 拉出你的小帶帶, 小帶帶拉開之後用三根手指頭. (17) [Subtitle]: 撐住你的外面, 這個時候往外掰開. (18) [Subtitle]: 往外掰開之後把安全帽戴上去, 扣起來. (19) [Subtitle]: 拿下來的時候也是, 用三根手指扶外面, 大拇指跟食指. (20) [Subtitle]: 撐開來, 因為你這樣子的做法呢. (21) [Subtitle]: 才不會破壞到你安全帽裡面的結構. [Slogan]: 觀看完整內容 印度安全帽.

narrative_and_purpose.mainPurpose: To educate motorcyclists on the importance of proper helmet-wearing techniques to avoid structural damage to the helmet and ensure maximum safety during an impact. The video uses a combination of expert demonstration and laboratory footage to build credibility.
